newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli ports unit plans $100 million bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Israeli ports unit plans $100 million bond issue.

text.p: The Israel Ports and Railways Authority said on Wednesday it was planning to make a $100 million private placement of bonds overseas.
The proceeds will be used to finance development of Israel's two principal ports in Haifa and Ashdod.
"The planned bond issue is at extremely attractive rates," said Shoresh Lerer, director of the authority.
He said the issue, to be placed with large foreign financial institutions, would be for 15 years and carry an interest rate of Libor plus 0.6 percent.

A Ports Authority spokesman said the issue, which was in the early stages of planning, was expected to take place by the end of January. Before the issue, Standard and Poor's and Moody's are expected to assign ratings.
